title: Does it hurt?
metaTitle: Does it hurt? - Si Shou Acupuncture and Wellness, PLLC
html: I am not going to lie to you...We are putting a very fine needle through your skin and frankly our X-Ray vision is terrible. It can be a smidge pokey. It should be very comfortable once the needles are in place. If it is not, simply let us know so we can modify the positioning of the needles.
